方芸愣在原地，眼底的羞窘终究没能压过震撼。

她鬼使神差地走上前去，查看伤口，却忍不住触碰上许默左肩的肌肤。

原本深可见骨、血肉外翻的恐怖豁口，此刻竟只剩下一道浅浅的粉色新痕。

顺着那道新痕，她的指尖不由自主地向下滑落，指腹擦过那犹如坚硬岩石般垒起的胸肌，最后停留在轮廓深邃的腹肌边缘。

指尖传来的滚烫体温，以及那强悍心跳，表示眼前这个男人已是脱胎换骨。

两人的呼吸在极其拉近的距离下交错，方芸猛地意识到了自己逾矩的动作，指尖立刻弹开。

她向后退开半步，慌乱地别过脸，心跳如擂鼓般。

许默轻咳一声，顺手从旁边的木架上扯下一件还算完好的麻布外套，随意地套在身上。

“别紧张，我还没自恋到以为能靠几块肉就把你迷得神魂颠倒。”

“昨晚我伤成那个鬼样子，身上的绷带只有你能打得这么死……救命之恩，谢了。”

这句话让方芸的脸颊瞬间红透。但很快，理智重新占据了高地。她猛然抬起头，满眼不可置信地上下打量着许默。

“你昨晚流的血连这石屋的地砖都浸透了……这才几个小时，一转眼就全好了？这根本不符合常理！”

许默不以为意地轻笑，摸了摸身边岩石墙壁。

“是这间营地的功劳，系统赋予了它强制回血的能力。只要这地方还在，咱们的生存几率就大多了，以后必须砸重金好好升级它。”

方芸却眉头紧锁，果断摇头否定。“不对！我承认营地有恢复生命值的能力，但在你昏迷的那个阶段，你掉血的速度简直像个漏水的筛子。营地那点杯水车薪的恢复量，绝对赶不上你掉血的速度！”

方芸的话很有道理，许默的笃定也开始动摇。

不是营地？

那还有什么东西能把他从鬼门关拽回来？

他的目光在屋内快速梭巡，最终定格在角落的那个破旧花盆上。

小草耷拉着脑袋。

许默皱了皱眉，仔细一看，它的叶子上缺了一个角。

难道是它，在自己昏迷期间割了自己的叶片，救活了自己？

总之，活下来了，比什么都重要。

他转身走到壁炉旁，一屁股坐在床板上，顺手往里添了一把干柴。火焰瞬间窜起，映暖了两人略显疲惫的脸庞。

“别想那些死里逃生的后怕了。”许默转头看向地上的小山。

“看看咱们拿命换来的战利品吧！”他最先从那堆杂物中挑出的，是一块散发着妖异灰光的晶体。

【低级魂雾碎片】。

仅仅只是握在手中，就能看到晶核内部有一团灰紫色的雾气在疯狂旋转、咆哮。

介绍中明确写着，可以用来改造装备。

Fang Yun froze on the spot, the embarrassment in her eyes could not overcome the shock.

She stepped forward to check the wound, but couldn't help but touch the skin of Xu Mo's left shoulder.

The terrifying gap that originally showed deep bones and flesh and blood was now only a shallow pink mark.

Following the new mark, her fingertips slid down involuntarily, and her fingertips brushed against the chest muscles that were built like a solid rock, and finally stopped at the edge of the deep-outlined abdominal muscles.

The hot body temperature coming from the fingertips and the strong heartbeat indicated that the man in front of him had been completely transformed.

The two people's breaths intertwined under the extremely close distance. Fang Yun suddenly realized that she had overstepped the rules, and her fingertips immediately flicked away.

She took half a step back and turned her face away in panic, her heart beating like a drum.

Xu Mo coughed lightly, pulled off a relatively intact linen jacket from the nearby wooden stand, and put it on casually.

"Don't be nervous, I'm not so narcissistic that I think I can charm you with just a few pieces of meat."

"I was injured like that last night. Only you can beat me to death with the bandages on my body...Thank you for saving my life."

This sentence made Fang Yun's cheeks turn red instantly.But soon, reason regained its high ground.She raised her head suddenly and looked Xu Mo up and down with disbelief.

"The blood you shed last night has soaked through the floor tiles of this stone house... It's only been a few hours, and it's all healed in the blink of an eye? This is totally unreasonable!"

Xu Mo chuckled nonchalantly and touched the rock wall next to him.

"It's the credit of this camp. The system has given it the ability to forcefully restore blood. As long as this place remains, our chances of survival will be much greater. We must spend a lot of money to upgrade it in the future."

Fang Yun frowned and shook her head decisively in denial."No! I admit that the camp has the ability to restore health, but at that stage when you were unconscious, your blood loss rate was like a leaky sieve. The camp's meager amount of recovery will definitely not be able to keep up with your blood loss rate!"

Fang Yun's words made sense, and Xu Mo's determination began to waver.

Not a campground?

So what else can pull him back from hell?

His eyes quickly roamed around the room, and finally settled on the old flower pot in the corner.

Xiaocao drooped his head.

Xu Mo frowned and took a closer look. There was a corner missing on its leaf.

Could it be that it cut off its own leaves while it was in a coma and saved itself?

In short, surviving is more important than anything else.

He turned around and walked to the fireplace, sat down on the bed and added a handful of dry wood.The flames shot up instantly, warming the slightly tired faces of the two people.

"Don't worry about those who escaped death." Xu Mo turned to look at the hill on the ground.

"Look at the trophies we sacrificed our lives for!" The first thing he picked out from the pile of debris was a crystal that exuded a strange gray light.

[Low-level soul mist fragments].

Just by holding it in your hand, you can see a gray-purple mist inside the crystal core spinning and roaring crazily.

The introduction clearly states that it can be used to modify equipment.
